data.title: Self-selected survey of IT job seekers in one national market (DOU)
data.summary: A web survey run on a national IT community site in March–April 2026, covering 3,777 professionals in the country, 943 working abroad, and 363 looking for a first job in the field. Respondents were not sampled: they answered a questionnaire published on a site they already read, and the publication states no recruitment method, response rate or weighting. It describes who chose to answer, which is a different population from everyone searching.
